fusions.name: Word of Command
fusions.desc: Barks a word of force across a cone 3.5 tiles long, which deals 12 damage to everything in it and stuns each enemy for 1 second.

fusions.name: Final Syllable
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 20 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more for each one.

fusions.name: Called Cadence
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 20% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Drilled Forms
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner. Your armour rises by 5%.
